principles: SQLite commit is authoritative for immediate local UX.
Blind last-write-wins is forbidden for financial/history-sensitive records.
Pending outbound events recorded while entitled must drain even after entitlement loss.

cases.name: Offline cash payment then reconnect
expected: tenant shows paid immediately after local commit
custody remains Cash with staff until handover
failed handover never reopens tenant obligation

cases.name: Two devices create independent payments for same obligation
expected: obligation projection recomputes from all events

cases.name: Same bed assigned concurrently
expected: both legitimate commitments are preserved long enough to detect conflict

cases.name: Entitlement expires before reconnect
cases.precondition: events were recorded while entitled or within valid offline grace
expected: outbox enters drain-only mode if needed
future gated actions remain blocked until entitlement is restored

cases.name: Remote reversal arrives after original payment
Local room transfer while remote device edits rent
expected: occupancy transfer and rent-term change remain separate events
transfer does not implicitly overwrite rent
if both are valid, both can coexist by effective date
semantic conflict only if effective-dated records truly overlap incompatibly

expected: checkpoint advances only after local transaction commits
